text:
emily: Received pen-test report PT-840 in our shared bucket. Executive summary: staging KMS key policy grants `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-deploy` decrypt rights, Dedicated hosts aren't writing SSM session transcripts to S3, and ALB/APIGW request bodies are redacted which blocks forensic replay. Need immediate triage, remediation plan, and retest window.
ryan: dropping the S3 path?
emily: s3://redwood-pt/reports/PT-840/2026-03-22/report.pdf
oz: tagging for KMS + terraform state concerns. Which alias is impacted?
emily: alias/redwood/staging-kms-v1. Report shows the policy principal entry for the CI role.
ryan: if CI role can decrypt artifacts that's a clear exfil path. Recommend mitigation in this order: 1) create replacement CMK + alias (staging-kms-v2) 2) remove `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-deploy` from old key policy 3) re-encrypt any secrets/state and update tf backend 4) rotate application secrets.
oz: hot-rotate is doable for staging but we must update terraform backend provider and `terraform state` references. I'll prepare a safe runbook.
sec-bot: Created ticket PT-840-REMED: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-840-REMED :page_with_curl:
emily: logging gaps: (A) SSM: we get StartSession in CloudTrail but not session transcripts (so no command logs). (B) ALB/APIGW: bodies are redacted for most routes; report suggests keeping full bodies for security-only retention with strict access controls.
ryan: for SSM transcripts we can enable session-manager plugin to push transcripts to a locked S3 bucket and also mirror to CloudWatch Logs with a KMS-encrypted log stream. Quick check: `aws ssm get-parameter --name /ssm/session-manager/s3-bucket` — will validate target.
oz: for ALB/APIGW bodies: proposal: route security-flagged traffic to a dedicated logging pipeline (Lambda -> s3://redwood-sec/pt-bodies/) encrypted with a CMK (alias/redwood/sec-archive) and 30d retention. PII redaction still required; we'll run a scrubber as part of ingestion.
oncall: I can page SRE and stand up monitoring during a maintenance window. Pick a slot.
emily: owners: KMS & tfstate -> oz. SSM transcript enable -> ryan. ALB/APIGW body archival -> emily. Proposed window: tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC. Anyone object?
ryan: OK for 02:00-03:00 (I can test SSM changes then).
oz: I'll take 02:00-03:30 for the key rotation + tfstate migration. Plan snippet I'll include in the runbook:```bash
# create new CMK
aws kms create-key --description "staging kms v2 for PT-840" --policy file://staging-kms-policy.json
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/staging-kms-v2 --target-key-id <key-id>
# patch old key policy (remove CI principal)
# migrate terraform backend
terraform init -reconfigure
terraform state mv 'module.backend.aws_s3_bucket_object.state' 'module.backend.aws_s3_bucket_object.state'
# re-encrypt state
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://state.enc --destination-key-id <new-key-id>
```
emily: example policy diff we'll include in evidence bundle: ```- "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-deploy" } + /* removed ci-deploy principal */```
sec-bot: Evidence folder prepared: s3://redwood-pt/evidence/PT-840/ (ACL: eng-security only)
ryan: for SSM transcripts I'll enable the S3 session target in the SSM logging config and validate by running a dummy session: ```aws ssm start-session --target i-0fabc123 --document-name AWS-StartInteractiveCommand``` Then check s3 prefix `sessions/{instance}/{timestamp}` for transcript.json.
oz: I'll also run a CloudTrail query to capture prior decrypt calls against the old key and stash the JSON in evidence: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:...:key/...`
emily: evidence checklist for vendor retest: - CMK creation CloudTrail events + key metadata - Key policy before/after diff - S3 object keys for SSM transcripts (redacted) - ALB/APIGW archival object keys + SHA256 checksums - Terraform backend migration log + state re-encrypt proof - Replay script that attempts the reported escalation path and its failure output (timestamped).
oncall: I'll schedule the page and stand by during the window. If anything breaks we abort and run rollback plan.
emily: retest ask to vendor: 1) re-run the escalation path against staging (timeboxed) 2) confirm SSM transcripts capture interactive commands and are accessible only to eng-security 3) attempt body-replay on archived requests to confirm tampering vector gone. Propose retest window tomorrow 09:00-10:30 UTC.
ryan: sending the vendor message now with interim evidence.
oz: adding tf commands and fallback alias script to the runbook.
emily: thanks team. Please drop short status updates in this thread during the maintenance window. :white_check_mark:
